findings.text: non-blocking: a pane refused the session claim never advances its cursor (the write at :375 is gated on self.persist), so every generation change re-reads every row written since it attached and re-feeds them through PaneRowPath; run transitions are suppressed by the pane's own remembered states, but a lift row is drawn on every feed — which the restart case at tests/test_a_follower_is_a_station_subscriber.py:78 states as its premise — so a second pane over one session repeats lift rows each time any event lands. No case drives a refused pane past a second event, so nothing reddens on it.

non-blocking: StationSubscriber.wake() has no production caller. reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:2119 drives its own poll/flush/stale loop on the subscriber branch, so the loop exists twice; only tests/test_a_follower_is_a_station_subscriber.py:204 and :236 exercise the second copy, and a reader of production code will learn the loop from the copy that is not covered by those cases.

non-blocking: the 60 s traced window names crew/live once beside the producer watch lease and the delivery lease, so the plan's measure ("no path under the crew home other than those two lease files") is not literally met; the manifest's evidence_inputs and the landing fragment both disclose it and attribute it to the retained recovery sweep that reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:2160 still runs on the subscriber path.

item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names the three pane suites, the retargeted freshness case and a 60 s strace with no crew-home path but two lease files; tests/test_follower_freshness.py:178 is retargeted at a station replacement and logs/gate-pane-suites.log records 58 passed EXIT=0 at 4d4a74a62, but logs/strace-measure.txt names a third crew-home family (crew/live) and the armed baseline arm at ab7098ee0 measures the repair round's delta rather than the node's pre-node base.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that crew follow becomes a subscriber reading its session's rows from the node station after a stored cursor; reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:3118 builds that subscriber and the wait branch at :2119 polls it, with a fallback to the producer stream where the node's store is absent, unbeaten or built from another crew home.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, nineteen commits, both armed arms with literal commands and EXIT lines (21 passed at ab7098ee0, 24 passed at f93b308e8), three negative-control logs, and its checkpoint correctly retracts the earlier landing figures its own logs had contradicted.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's five declared source paths, two test files, the fragment and the figure directory; every path in the diff --stat for c30c057d4..eb435418a is inside them, and the figure sits in the declared figure directory the coordinator gave its own figure-review dispatch.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_follower_is_a_station_subscriber.py:78 reddens when the cursor is not persisted (logs/negative-no-cursor.log, 3 failed EXIT=1) and :503 reddens when _station_subscriber_for returns None (logs/negative-station-wiring.log, 1 failed EXIT=1), both printed in this review's reading; the refused-pane repeat at station_subscriber.py:375 has no such control.
justifications.evidence: both armed arms record zero failures with matching EXIT=0 summaries in logs/baseline-armed.log and logs/after-armed.log, and the wider importer-population arms at logs/baseline-suite.log (1 failed, 488 passed) and logs/after-suite.log (1 failed, 497 passed) fail the same test id, so the added set is genuinely empty; the trace's third crew-home family is disclosed rather than hidden.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/station_subscriber.py:1 follows the module-docstring and section-comment style of reckon/crew/station_store.py and introduces no plan, sprint or ticket label, and logs/ruff-delta.log shows the empty tuple _UNSET sentinel and the S608 noqa sit at the base's own two SIM findings with the same single unformatted file.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:3118 hands crew follow a StationSubscriber and the branch at :2119 polls, flushes and prints its rows, but ticker.PaneRowPath is still built per subscriber at reckon/crew/station_subscriber.py:149 rather than once per audience in the station as section 8's design paragraph says.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/station_store.py:1086 makes events_for and events one _read_events owner, and PaneRowPath, cap_history, parse_stream_line and follower_registration._FollowerRegistration are all extended rather than re-implemented; the exception is StationSubscriber.wake() at station_subscriber.py:400, a second poll loop beside the one in crew_follow_commands.py:2119.
